# Britannica's Curiosity Compass

> > An interactive platform by Britannica for discovering and understanding personal curiosity types through assessments, science-backed research, and biographical profiles of history's most curious minds.

Britannica's Curiosity Compass helps users explore their curiosity dimensions through personality assessments and learning type identification. The platform features biographical content on innovative thinkers, artists, and cultural icons who exemplified curiosity throughout history.

## Key Topics

- Curiosity Assessment
- Curiosity Types
- Personality Quiz
- Learning Types
- Self-Discovery
- Curiosity Science
- Historical Figures
- Innovators and Artists
- Marie Curie
- Frida Kahlo
- Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
- Ludwig van Beethoven
- Salvador Dali
- Cultural Icons

## Curiosity Assessment Platform

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Britannica's Curiosity Compass: interactive curiosity assessment platform

## Curious People & Biographies

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass: Curious People](https://curiosity.britannica.com/curious-people-biographies): Biographies of curious innovators like Frida Kahlo and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
